duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا وَاجْعَلْنَا مُسْلِمَيْنِ لَكَ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِنَا أُمَّةً مُسْلِمَةً لَّكَ وَأَرِنَا مَنَاسِكَنَا وَتُبْ عَلَيْنَا إِنَّكَ أَنتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيمُ
duas.transliteration: Rabbanā wajʿalnā muslimayni laka wa min dhurriyyatinā ummatam muslimatan laka wa arinā manāsikanā wa tub ʿalaynā innaka Antat-Tawwābur-Raḥīm.
duas.translation: Our Lord! make of us Muslims, bowing to Thy (Will), and of our progeny a people Muslim, bowing to Thy (will); and show us our place for the celebration of (due) rites; and turn unto us (in Mercy); for Thou art the Oft-Returning, Most Merciful.

duas.arabic: لَا يُكَلِّفُ اللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا لَهَا مَا كَسَبَتْ وَعَلَيْهَا مَا اكْتَسَبَتْ رَبَّنَا لَا تُؤَاخِذْنَا إِن نَّسِينَا أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا رَبَّنَا وَلَا تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْنَا إِصْرًا كَمَا حَمَلْتَهُ عَلَى الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِنَا رَبَّنَا وَلَا تُحَمِّلْنَا مَا لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِ وَاعْفُ عَنَّا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَا أَنتَ مَوْلَانَا فَانصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ
duas.transliteration: Lā yukallifullāhu nafsan illā wusʿahā, lahā mā kasabat wa ʿalayhā maktasabat. Rabbanā lā tu’ākhidhnā in nasīnā aw akhṭa’nā. Rabbanā wa lā taḥmil ʿalaynā iṣran kamā ḥamaltahū ʿalal-ladhīna min qablinā. Rabbanā wa lā tuḥammilnā mā lā ṭāqata lanā bih, waʿfu ʿannā waghfir lanā warḥamnā. Anta Mawlānā fanṣurnā ʿalal-qawmil-kāfirīn.
duas.translation: On no soul doth Allah place a burden greater than it can bear. It gets every good that it earns, and it suffers every ill that it earns. (Pray:) 'Our Lord! Condemn us not if we forget or fall into error, our Lord! Lay not on us a burden like that which Thou didst lay on those before us; our Lord! Lay not on us a burden greater than we have strength to bear. Blot out our sins, and grant us forgiveness. Have mercy on us. Thou art our Protector; help us against those who stand against faith.'

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تُزِغْ قُلُوبَنَا بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَيْتَنَا وَهَبْ لَنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةً إِنَّكَ أَنتَ الْوَهَّابُ رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ جَامِعُ النَّاسِ لِيَوْمٍ لَّا رَيْبَ فِيهِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يُخْلِفُ الْمِيعَادَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbanā lā tuzigh qulūbanā baʿda idh hadaytanā wa hab lanā milladunka raḥmah, innaka Antal-Wahhāb. Rabbanā innaka jāmiʿun-nāsi li Yawmil-lā rayba fīh; innallāha lā yukhliful-mīʿād.
duas.translation: Our Lord! let not our hearts deviate after Thou hast guided us, and grant us mercy from Thy presence, for Thou art the Grantor of bounties. Our Lord! Thou art He that will gather mankind together against a Day about which there is no doubt. Surely Allah never fails in His promise.

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا اصْرِفْ عَنَّا عَذَابَ جَهَنَّمَ إِنَّ عَذَابَهَا كَانَ غَرَامًا إِنَّهَا سَاءَتْ مُسْتَقَرًّا وَمُقَامًا
duas.transliteration: Rabbanāṣrif ʿannā ʿadhāba Jahannama inna ʿadhābahā kāna gharāmā. Innahā sā’at mustaqarranw-wa muqāmā.
duas.translation: Our Lord! avert from us the Wrath of Hell, for its Wrath is indeed a grievous affliction. Evil indeed is it as an abode, and as a place to rest in.

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَا أَنفُسَنَا وَإِن لَّمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمْنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْخَاسِرِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbanā ẓalamnā anfusana wa illam taghfir lanā wa tarḥamnā lanakūnanna minal-khāsirīn.
duas.translation: Our Lord! We have wronged our own selves; if Thou forgive us not and bestow not upon us Thy Mercy, we shall certainly be lost.

duas.arabic: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ وَارْحَمْ وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ الرَّاحِمِينَ
duas.translation: O my Lord! grant Thou forgiveness and mercy, for Thou art the Best of those who show mercy.

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تَجْعَلْنَا فِتْنَةً لِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ أَنتَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ
duas.transliteration: Rabbanā lā tajʿalnā fitnatal-lilladhīna kafarū waghfir lanā Rabbanā innaka Antal-ʿAzīzul-Ḥakīm.
duas.translation: Our Lord! Make us not a (test and) trial for the Unbelievers, but forgive us, our Lord! for Thou art the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةً وَهَيِّئْ لَنَا مِنْ أَمْرِنَا رَشَدًا
duas.transliteration: Rabbanā ātinā mil-ladunka raḥmatanw-wa hayyi’ lanā min amrinā rashadā.
duas.translation: Our Lord! bestow on us Mercy from Thyself, and dispose of our affair for us in the right way!
